item.text: I’m checking the 7B dossier against sources that can actually speak to Trọng’s own conduct, not just Vietnam’s general corruption climate. The first pass will prioritize direct statements, legal/official records, and independent reporting on appointments, anti-corruption actions, and any documented conflicts or scrutiny.
